sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents and perused the record.

It is sought to be contended by the petitioners herein (23 in number) that they are farmers of Tehsil & Pargana Karwi, District Chitrakoot and their lands in various Gata numbers in paragraph no. 6 of the writ petition got submerged on account of construction of Chaudhari Charan Singh Rasin Dam Project, Village Rasin, District Chitrakoot, work of which was commenced in the year 2009-10 when acquisition proceeding with respect to the land for construction of Dam initiated.
The submission is that the Dam is now completed in March, 2021 and has been inaugurated also.
Various representations have been filed by the petitioners to the administrative authorities such as the District Magistrate, Chitrakoot as also the Executive Engineer, Irrigation Construction Division,
Karwi, Chitrakoot.

sentences.text: Various communications issued by the departmental authority namely the Executive Engineer concerned has been placed before the Court to assert that the compensation has not been paid till date.

Be that as it may, in case, the land of the petitioners has been acquired by the competent authority by proceeding under the Land Acquisition Act, it is open for them to approach the competent authority namely the Special Land Acquisition Officer to seek compensation by presenting the papers pertaining to their entitlement to the land in question.

However, in case, the land of the petitioners has been utilized without any acquisition proceeding and got sub-merged on account of the construction of Dam without giving them compensation or rehabilitate them, it is open for the petitioners to approach the Committee constituted by the State Government pursuant to the Government Order dated 12th May, 2016.

The said Government Order has been placed before us by the learned Standing Counsel indicates that the District Level Committee comprising of seven members including the Additional District Magistrate (Finance & Revenue), the officer of Irrigation Department and other local department has been constituted to examine such claim.
We, therefore, relegate the petitioners to approach the District Magistrate, Chitrakoot by writing proper representations laying their specific grievance about acquisition/utilization of their lands.

In case, such representations are filed by the petitioners within a period of two weeks from today alongwith the copy of this order, the District Magistrate, Chitrakoot shall be under obligation to examine their claim and place the matter before the appropriate authority, in case, the land of the petitioners have been acquired by adopting due procedure.

However, in case, their land has been utilized without acquisition proceedings, the claim made by the petitioners shall be placed before the Committee constituted under the Government Order dated 12th May, 2016.

In any case, on the representations moved by the petitioners within the time given above before the District Magistrate, a decision, in accordance with law, has to be taken by the District Magistrate,
Chitrakoot for referring the matter before the competent authority within a period of three weeks,
thereafter.
The concerned authority before whom the claim of the petitioners is laid, shall be under obligation to decide the same within a further period of six weeks, thereafter.
The decision of the competent authority shall duly be intimated to the petitioners.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
